description.value:
You fire a spread of neurotoxin-laced darts. Choose any number of creatures you can see within range; each must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or suffer an effect keyed to its current hit points: 60 hit points or fewer, poisoned for 1 minute; 50 hit points or fewer, poisoned and deafened for 1 minute; 40 hit points or fewer, poisoned, deafened, and blinded for 10 minutes; 30 hit points or fewer, poisoned, blinded, deafened, and stunned for 1 hour; 20 hit points or fewer, slain instantly.

This power has no effect on droids or constructs.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 7
